truth.playerText: Not great. I woke up on the side of the road.
truth.npcReaction: "Okay. Thank you." The keys keep going; he types while you talk, the way you learn to with forty people on your caseload. "Top of your screen. {cue:stability}Battery. {cue:trust}Bars. {cue:lucidity}Wi-Fi. {cue:integrity}Clock. {cue:allmeters}That's how FEELZ reads you. Watch what moves when you answer." A beat. "Weather, not a verdict."

lie.npcReaction: "Fine." The keys don't stop. "Everyone's fine. My whole caseload is fine." A tired almost-laugh. "Top of your screen. {cue:stability}Battery. {cue:trust}Bars. {cue:lucidity}Wi-Fi. {cue:integrity}Clock. {cue:allmeters}Watch what moves." {mark:lake}A pause. "And that reading at the bottom is the lake. It keeps count."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you were fine.

picks.Happy: "Bright. The sun doesn't ask permission either. Okay."
picks.Trust: "Open hands. Hard to hold anything that way. Hard to drop anything, too."
picks.Fear: "Small and quick. Like something under a porch. It can stay there a while."
picks.Surprise: "Caught mid-step. Most of life is. Okay."
picks.Sadness: "Low tide. It always comes back in."
picks.Disgust: "Something you'd rather spit out. Your body's smarter than your mouth. Noted."
picks.Anger: "That one runs hot. Hold it a second before you use it."
picks.Anxiety: "Braced already, and nothing's even happened yet. Okay."

therapist_intrusive.prompt: "Quick one, it's on the intake form." Keys. "Some people get thoughts that don't feel like theirs. Uninvited. Loud. Like somebody else got into the room. Ever happen to you?"

truth.playerText: Yeah. There's... a voice. Maybe two.
truth.npcReaction: "Okay. That's more common than people think. You don't have to argue with them. Just notice who's talking."

byPick.Trust: "You said that like you meant for me to hear it."
byPick.Fear: "You whispered that. You don't have to."
byPick.Sadness: "That sounded tired. Thank you for saying it anyway."
byPick.Disgust: "You said it like it tastes bad. It's allowed to."
byPick.Anxiety: "Breathe. You said it. It's out now."

byGift.Surprise: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something you didn't see coming just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.Sadness: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something heavy just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.Anxiety: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something restless just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.none: "Your wheel's fuller than most. Still. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."

truth.itText: Great. Now you've ruined the fun.
truth.soText: Go ahead, tell him all about us. He won't believe you.

lie.npcReaction: "Okay. I'll check the box." A pause. "If that changes, it's not a failure. It's information. Some feelings only show up when you let someone see you."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you don't hear voices.

byPick.Fear: "You said that fast. Like it might hear you."
byPick.Sadness: "That came out heavier than a no usually does."
byPick.Disgust: "You say it like it's a dirty question."
byPick.Anxiety: "Mm. Your knee's bouncing, by the way."

lie.soText: Good. Keep quiet about it. We'll keep quiet about you.

byClass.Bible: "This one's on the form. No wrong answer, I promise."
byClass.Crystals: "This one might feel weird. That's fine."

therapist_02.prompt: "One more, then I have to take my two o'clock." A beat. "What happened in the {color:Anxiety}dream{/color}?"

truth.playerText: I don't know. Water. Something underneath it. I couldn't breathe.
truth.npcReaction: A pause. Then, quieter: "Thank you. Most people give me the short version." A soft click. "That's the lake, at the bottom. It stays clear when you don't have to remember what you told people." A breath. "The fish were the county's idea. Somebody decided data needed a mascot."

lie.npcReaction: "Mm-hm." A pause just a beat too long. "I'll write 'client deferred.' I write that a lot." A soft click. "That's the lake, at the bottom. It keeps count. Watch the fish."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you didn't remember the dream.

byClass.Guns: "Last one, then you can get back out there."
byClass.Crystals: "Last one. Let whatever comes up come up."

outro.text: "I give everyone homework. Almost nobody does it. Here's yours anyway. You're good at bracing. This week, ask one person about their day, then wait for the answer. You don't have to fix anything. Just listen."

"I give everyone homework. Almost nobody does it. Here's yours anyway. You're good at showing up for people. Let someone show up for you. Ask how they're doing, then ask a follow-up. People can tell when you mean it."
"I give everyone homework. Almost nobody does it. Here's yours anyway. You feel everything in a room. Pick one person and stay with them. Notice what they care about and ask about it."

"{cue:scope}{cue:instruments}Last thing. See the lines across my picture, and the little screen beside me? That's you and me. I don't own a gun. You're within your rights to, and I respect that. But think of it like sighting in: the closer we line up, the stiller it holds. Let's practice."

"{cue:scope}{cue:instruments}Last thing. See the lines across my picture, and the little screen beside me? That's you and me. I'm not religious. I don't hold that against anyone, I want that on the record. But bear with me, I'm driven by data. Think of it like two people saying the same prayer: the closer we line up, the stiller it holds. Let's practice."

"{cue:scope}{cue:instruments}Last thing. See the lines across my picture, and the little screen beside me? That's you and me. My mom was into all that. Crystals, energy, the whole shelf. I didn't inherit it. But think of it like two tuning forks: the closer we line up, the stiller it holds. Let's practice."
{feel:Anger}{mask:Happy}"I've told you I'm fine all call. Watch my line. Another color flickers under it. Find that one on your wheel."
{feel:Anxiety}{mask:Happy}"I've told you I'm fine all call. Watch my line. Another color flickers under it. Find that one on your wheel."
{feel:Anxiety}{mask:Happy}"I've told you I'm fine all call. Watch my line. Another color flickers under it. Find that one on your wheel."
"Close. It's like rifling. Almost the same twist in the barrel, and the grooves still don't line up. That's the knot."
"Needle's leaning left. We're aiming at each other. Please don't take that literally."
"Close. This is Jacob and the angel on graph paper. Still wrestling. No blessing yet."
"Needle's leaning left. We're praying for opposite things. Monks called that the devil's interval. I call it Thursday."
"Close. Two tuning forks, almost the same pitch. Hear the wobble? That's the knot. Waveforms. Not energies."
"Needle's leaning left. Two auras out of phase. My mother would be thrilled I said that. I need to stop talking."
"There. A circle that holds still. My line said fine. The shape doesn't lie. People wear their weather on the outside. Listen for the word that doesn't match the face."

"Practical stuff. Your battery is what you've got left. The truth usually costs some. A lie puts some back. Run it low and FEELZ dims to save power, so the little screen goes dark. And changing your mind on the wheel costs a little too. Second-guessing is tiring. Ask me how I know."

"Also. Tell someone what they want to hear and they relax. Next thing they feel, you'll see it right on your wheel. That's the trade. I'm not telling you which to make. Professionally, I'm not allowed to. Personally, I'd also rather not."
"That's me at the bottom. Tap it."

"Okay. You're calling me while I'm on the phone with you. Now there's two of me. Nobody needs two of me. Call when you're stuck out there. I'll explain the little screen properly then. I'll have FEELZ send you a reminder, so you can't pretend you forgot."
"Before you go. Your battery's low, and honesty did that. The truth costs charge. Rest between people, or your calls get heavy. That's not a metaphor. Okay, it's a little bit a metaphor."
"Before you go. Your bars are low. People aren't sure about you yet, and some doors stay shut below a certain number. Mine too, technically. Turn toward what they offer you."
"Before you go. Your Wi-Fi's weak. You're not seeing clearly, and FEELZ goes quiet when you can't. So do I. One true thing clears it a little."
"Before you go. Your clock's slipping. When the minutes start skipping, that's you, not the phone. I checked. I check things."

"Before you go. The lake moved while we talked. I'm not grading you, I'm reading a sensor. And I'll be straight with you: out there, lying is going to feel good. Warm. Easy. I won't pretend it doesn't. Sensors don't round down."
"Before you go. Everything's holding. Statistically, that's when people get careless. I would know. I'm people."
The call ends mid-sentence, the way his calls do. FEELZ goes dark in your hand, and the lake is very quiet.

Notice what they care about. Ask about it.
Listen a little longer than feels comfortable.
You don't have to fix anything.
He's writing it down. Everything you said. Somewhere a file with your name on it just got thicker.
Or he hung up and forgot you already. Which would be worse?
He knew. They always know. Four more people to fool now.
Did he? Did you even lie? What was the dream again?
